narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as the US-Iran conflict escalates beyond a one-off exchange, with Iran shooting down a US Apache and threatening further strikes, while Israel intensifies operations on two fronts. The EIA's extended Hormuz blockade timeline through 2026 compounds the risk, driving oil prices higher and reinforcing a defensive posture across equities and crypto.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil futures and short S&P 500 index futures, hedging with gold or US Treasuries.

narratives.title: Hormuz Blockade Structural Impact
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into energy and commodity-linked assets as the Hormuz blockade persists structurally, with Kuwait seeking pipeline bypasses and the EIA raising WTI forecasts to $88.32. The blockade's economic bite is confirmed, but diplomatic off-ramps create uncertainty, keeping flows neutral-to-bullish rather than outright risk-on.
narratives.trade_implication: Buy energy sector ETFs and long-dated WTI futures, while shorting consumer discretionary stocks sensitive to oil prices.

narratives.title: Institutional Crypto Adoption Accelerates
narratives.summary: Despite a macro-driven BTC crash, capital is flowing into crypto infrastructure as institutional partnerships like Ethena with Janus Henderson signal long-term adoption. The selloff is not crypto-specific, and whale accumulation persists, but near-term risk-off sentiment caps upside, keeping flows neutral.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate Bitcoin on dips via futures or ETFs, and buy Ethena (ENA) tokens on institutional partnership news, with a 6-month horizon.
